answer_line: Low-resolution handwritten digits, 0–9 (MNIST-style), rendered as white (~+1) 1–2-pixel-wide strokes on a black (−1) background. Each digit is centred, occupying roughly rows 1–10 and columns 2–9 (about 8 px wide, 10 px tall), with the outermost row/column always black; the lower-right and lower-left corners of that box are used less. Different samples show different digits (loops like 0/6/8/9, a 7 with top bar and diagonal, a central vertical 1, digits with a mid crossbar such as 3/4/5, a 2 with a hooked bottom), with the usual handwriting variation in slant and thickness.
